direction-type.words: Possible but not mandatory chromatic changes in auxiliary tones:
The upper auxiliary tone near the seventh of the chord
does not allow for chromatic lowering:
the root of the seventh chord sounds good:
An auxiliary tone near a doubled note is only
possible if the doubling is at least an octave away.
For the doubling third of a chord, stricter rules apply,
auxiliary tone near to doubling third are only possible in
sixth chords and at least an octave away.
